AU footer agreement has service-area, authorised-service, wear-item and full-manual qualifications; inline NZ agreement limits its warranty to NZ. newSanyRecord.evidenceNote: As checked on 11 October 2026, Prancer NSW/ACT advertises a New SANY SE 588 right-hand-drive 6x4 588 kWh composite prime mover at A$380,000 plus GST and on-road costs (A$418,000 including GST). Its heavy-truck dealer card claims In Stock Now. The linked Australia brochure identifies SYGN588F / host KEV126158692, printed version 2026-01-09; exact binding to the advertised SE588 build remains unresolved.
limitations: New and 2026 are seller/marketplace labels, not independently verified unit condition, factory model year or build date. Dealer In Stock Now is a model-level claim without a verified physical allocation.

The SE588 advert gives height 3825 mm without naming a loading/measurement condition; the linked Australia brochure gives unladen height 3800 mm. They also differ on axle ratings (advert 8/11.5/11.5 t; brochure 7.5/13/13 t) and 20–80% charging time (advert ?60 minutes; brochure ≤55 minutes). Exact current build, measurement basis and revision remain unresolved.

Seller claims 25000 kg GVW; the linked brochure omits GVW and Terramotive says GVM TBA. Technical GCM is separately 50000 kg single trailer / 80000 kg double trailers, not verified universal Australian operating mass or payload.

Terramotive labels the generic family off-road classification Yes, prints 4475 mm wheelbase versus the brochure/advert 3800+1350 mm, and has kW/kWh battery unit inconsistencies. No exact Australian road approval was independently established in this bounded pass.

Dealer 350 km range lacks a stated load/test protocol. 13300 kg curb/cab-chassis tare does not establish goods payload. Advertised price excludes on-road costs and unconfirmed options/delivery; no drive-away total is established.

The advert separately claims CCS2 and 400 kW maximum DC charging; the brochure lists CCS2/GB/T alternatives and does not state maximum charging kW. Brochure motor output is 330 kW rated versus 480 kW peak. Keep these source/version claims distinct; no exact current charging configuration or homologated continuous output is established.

Direct HTTP for advert 1276587 returned 403. Advert-specific claims are supported by the retained successful same-day web-tool extraction, with New/name/price corroborated by an unchanged same-day Prancer directory tile. The error HTML is not offer evidence. The brochure says it is for reference only and specifications may change without prior notice.
